title: When the Cellar Turns
author: Ada Zhou
blurb: Xanthe Coldharbour, the new teacher at a school with a missing-class problem, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then every mirror in the house starts reflecting the room one second late — and they are pulled straight into the middle of it. Now they must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
